scripts.deps: uv sync && docker compose --env-file ../.env pull && docker compose --env-file ../.env build && mkdir -p tests/downloads && sudo chmod 777 tests/downloads
scripts.swarm:test:presta: (sudo chmod 777 tests/downloads) && (set -a && source ../.env && set +a && uv run tests/presta.py)
scripts.sel:restart: SE_START_VNC=false docker compose --env-file ../.env down && docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d
scripts.sel:restart:vnc: SE_START_VNC=true docker compose --env-file ../.env down && docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d
